text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — need final copy snippets for website (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) + 2 launch-post hooks, short webinar narrative (30m), and inbound lead routing rules. Target: publish next Tues. Any objections? :calendar:

Jamal Ortiz: No objections. I can draft headlines for each mode. Do we want separate CTAs per mode or 1 global CTA?

Maria Chen: Separate CTAs please — routing will send users to different sign-up flows. Also need 1 modular hero line that can be swapped for A/B.

Elaine Park: Kicker idea for Hosted: "Ship LLM features faster — managed inference with predictable latency." Short hero: "Hosted API for instant LLM in prod." CTA: "Try Hosted API"

Sachin Patel: Dedicated headline: "Reserved GPU capacity, guaranteed throughput." Short hero: "Dedicated capacity — steady performance at scale." CTA: "Request Dedicated"

Noah - Growth: Private page should lead with compliance + control. Kicker: "Private deployments for regulated data and VPC control." Hero: "Private (VPC/on‑prem) inference — data stays where you need it." CTA: "Talk to Sales"

Maria Chen: Nice. Need two short social/launch-post hooks that we can use on X/LinkedIn and in the product newsletter. Keep under 140 chars each.

Elaine Park: Hook A: "New: Redwood Inference — same API, now with Hosted, Dedicated & Private options so you pick the economics that fit."

Sachin Patel: Hook B: "Ship faster, run cheaper, and stay compliant. Meet the inference runtime that adapts to your needs. Webinar Thurs. RSVP -> link."

Maria Chen: Webinar blurb (30s elevator):
content-bot: "Join Redwood’s product team for a 30-minute demo & playbook: serving LLMs in production across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. We'll walk through latency/cost benchmarks, routing strategies, and how to choose the right mode for your product. Q&A at the end."

Jamal Ortiz: For the website, we should add a tiny benchmark summary line under each hero: e.g., "Median p95 generation latency: 120ms (Hosted), 95ms (Dedicated), 130ms (Private, depends on infra)." Use approximate numbers and link to full benchmarks page.

Noah - Growth: Inbound lead routing rules — propose simple deterministic rules in product order:

launch-bot: ```yaml
# inbound-routing (example)
if request.path contains "/private" -> route: sales_private_queue
elif query.param contains "dedicated" -> route: pm_dedicated_leads
elif utm.campaign == "webinar" -> route: webinar_attendees_list
else -> route: self_serve_trial
```

Elaine Park: For messaging iteration plan: 1) publish page variants A/B (Hero swap + CTA) 2) run webinar, collect registrant tag 3) route registrants to nurture: hosted -> self-serve nurture, dedicated -> capacity consult, private -> sales-led.

Maria Chen: Can we get short microcopy for the three CTAs (one line each) to use on buttons and microcopy under forms?

Sachin Patel: Hosted CTA microcopy: "Start a free Hosted trial — no infra to manage."

Jamal Ortiz: Dedicated CTA microcopy: "Book capacity planning — predictable throughput."

Elaine Park: Private CTA microcopy: "Schedule a private deployment consult."

Noah - Growth: Small ask — include a 1-sentence objection-handling nugget under each hero for sales/nurture email. I’ll draft if you want.

Maria Chen: Yes please @Noah. Also @Sachin can you push final copy into the staging content sheet by EOD Fri? I'll assemble the webinar invite and funnel config after that. :rocket:

Sachin Patel: On it. Will drop text and the routing YAML into the sheet.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — this is the last pass before copy freeze. If you have word-smithing suggestions drop them here. Otherwise I’ll book the webinar slot and prep the newsletter content tomorrow.

content-bot: (automated) draft-export: https://docs.internal/redwood/launch/orbit-copy-draft — please review. :memo:
